title: Connecting Score Matching, Maximum Likelihood, and Expectation-Maximization in Mixed Linear Regression
abstract: arXiv:2609.05688v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study variance-preserving diffusion of the response in mixed linear regression (MLR) with unknown mixing weights. Our analysis separates the statistical guarantees of score matching from the loss geometry and optimization signal at a fixed diffusion noise level. The KL divergence links the denoising score matching objective integrated over the diffusion path with the likelihood and a terminal discrepancy. Under mild regularity conditions and terminal schedule, the resulting estimator converges up to the ground truth parameters of MLR, and its scaled error converges to the Gaussian limit of the maximum-likelihood estimator. At a fixed scale of the diffusion noise level, we derive a decomposition linking the score matching loss to cross-entropy and Expectation-Maximization (EM) operators. translated_abstract: 我们研究了在具有未知混合权重的混合线性回归（MLR）中响应变量的方差保持扩散问题。我们的分析将得分匹配的统计保证与固定扩散噪声水平下的损失几何结构和优化信号分离开来。KL散度将在扩散路径上积分的去噪得分匹配目标与似然函数及终端差异联系起来。在温和的正则性条件和终端调度下，所得估计器收敛于MLR的真实参数，且其缩放误差收敛到最大似然估计器的高斯极限。在固定扩散噪声水平尺度下，我们推导出一个将得分匹配损失与交叉熵和期望最大化（EM）算子联系起来的分解。该分解产生了一个与EM相关的低噪声梯度展开，其中包含潜在方差的额外修正项。在高噪声极限下，我们（摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: 该论文在混合线性回归中建立了得分匹配损失与最大似然估计及期望最大化（EM）算子之间的理论联系，证明了基于扩散的估计器能收敛到真实参数并达到最大似然估计的高斯极限。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes theoretical connections between the score matching loss and maximum likelihood estimation as well as expectation-maximization (EM) operators in mixed linear regression, proving that diffusion-based estimators converge to the ground truth parameters and achieve the Gaussian limit of the maximum-likelihood estimator.
